subject: FinWorks MAP: compliance milestones, SOC 2 / SIG / DPA clarifications
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finworks.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@finworks.com, procurement@finworks.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA asks

Hi Sean / Laura,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — FinWorks is excited to move from evaluation to procurement. Before we lock timelines we need a short mutual action plan that captures the compliance gates we'll use for acceptance. High-level asks from our security and procurement teams:

- SOC 2 Type II report and any current gap remediations
- Completed SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet (we'll provide the canonical copy)
- DPA redline (we may ask for a narrow retention carveout)
- Confirmation of data retention for: production PII, backups, audit logs (S3 buckets / logs)

To help with internal approvals, can you propose a recommended MAP with milestone owners and target dates? Our procurement target for signature is end of July, so we need to confirm the compliance checkpoint dates this week.

Attachments: FinWorks_MAP_v0.3.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Marta
Director, IT Risk & Security
FinWorks

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finworks.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA asks

Marta — thanks for the clear list. I've drafted a brief MAP and attached our SOC 2 artifact set and the SIG template you can drop into. Key dates below (proposal):

- 2027-05-24: Redwood returns completed SIG spreadsheet (first pass)
- 2027-05-28: Security technical call to review SOC 2 scope & CAIQ answers
- 2027-06-04: Legal swaps DPA redline (we'll aim to return within 3 business days)
- 2027-06-15: Final evidence package uploaded to secure share (SOC 2, penetration test summary, key diagrams)
- 2027-07-29: Target for DocuSign signature (procurement ops)

Short notes on retention while legal and security review the DPA:
- Production customer PII: retained per customer configuration — default 90 days; we support configurable retention policies per customer (can be set to 180 days or shorter).
- Backups / disaster recovery: encrypted incremental backups retained for up to 90 days by default; long-term archives are a separate administrative process and require a documented retention justification (typical enterprise addendum available).
- Audit logs / telemetry: we retain operational logs for 365 days by default; we can export compressed logs on a schedule for longer-term archival if you need >1 year.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf); Redwood_SIG_CAIX_Spreadsheet_template.xlsx (xlsx)

I'll also propose a 30-minute compliance alignment call on 2027-05-28 at 10:00 PT — Laura and Rishi will join to cover SOC 2 scope and technical architecture. If that works, I can send an invite.

—Sean
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finworks.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA asks

Marta — quick technical mapping to items you called out so your security reviewers can preview:

- SOC 2: We have a current Type II report for period ending 2026-11-30. The report covers logical access, change management, and incident response. See attached SOC 2 PDF.
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll populate the spreadsheet with references and evidence links. For high-sensitivity controls (encryption, key management), our answers will reference: KMS-backed keys (AWS KMS / customer-managed keys for Private deployments), TLS 1.2+ in transit, and AES-256 at rest.
- DPA: Our standard DPA allows configurable retention windows up to 3 years for log exports; enterprise addendum supports longer retention periods upon request and with appropriate risk acceptance. We'll flag the "backups" and "long-term archive" rows for legal review.
- Logs / Retention details: operational logs stored in an encrypted S3 bucket (us-west-2), access limited to SRE + SOC team via IAM roles. Audit logs (auth events) retained 365 days; requestable export for longer retention.

Deliverable plan (we'll upload to the secure share in a week):
1) Completed SIG spreadsheet with evidence links
2) SOC 2 attestation + summary of any current open remediations
3) DPA marked-up redline (legal)

If FinWorks needs a guaranteed contractual retention term of 6–7 years, that will follow our enterprise addendum path (security review + ops documentation). For MAP planning, can you indicate whether 365 days or 6 years is your expected baseline? That will affect the legal timeline.

Attachment references: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf; Redwood_SIG_CAIX_Spreadsheet_template.xlsx

- Laura
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finworks.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA asks

Laura / Sean — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few clarifications from security / procurement:

1) Retention target: FinWorks baseline requirement is 6 years for audit artifacts; for active PII we prefer 180 days but can accept 365 if necessary. We need confirmation that Redwood can export compressed audit logs on demand to support 6-year archival.
2) Backups: Does Redwood perform immutability (WORM) or is that handled post-export by the customer? We may need an addendum to cover immutable archives for certain regulated files.
3) DPA: our legal team will send a redline (expected today). Are you able to commit to a 7 business-day turnaround on DPA review for this deal? Procurement is targeting contract execution by 2027-07-29 (end of July).

Also — please add a HubSpot activity ID so our procurement ops can trace the MAP: hubspot activity = HS-49872.

Thanks,
Marta
(On behalf of FinWorks security / procurement)

From: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finworks.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + SOC 2 / SIG / DPA asks

Marta — good questions, and we can support your procurement timeline. Quick responses and next steps: 

- Export for 6-year archival: yes — we can export compressed audit logs on request (CSV + gz) and place them in a customer-controlled S3 bucket. We'll include the export playbook in the evidence bundle.
- Backup immutability: our standard backups are not WORM by default. For immutability requirements we offer an enterprise archive option (we'll work with ops to configure object lock in the customer's archive bucket). We'll note that as a MAP action item for legal/ops.
- DPA turnaround: legal will prioritize a 7 business-day turnaround for this deal once we have your redline in-hand; please send the redline to contracts@redwood.com and cc me.

MAP owner assignments (updated):
- Redwood: Laura (security), Rishi (legal/contract), Sean (deal owner / procurement cadence)
- FinWorks: Marta (security), procurement@finworks.com (procurement)

I will send calendar invites for the 2027-05-28 technical call and a 2027-06-01 legal sync. I'll also upload a MAP tracker to the secure share and link it in HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/FW-2027-087
